title: Damage calculation and runtime coefficient controls

elementNames.provenance: OpenKh primary format documentation names EnemyParam72..84; native3C2240 proves the corresponding runtime byte mapping.

implementation.lifetime: One-time writes to current player or manually locked living enemy. Pool/list/backlink validation; no pointer retained.
implementation.persistence: No save, source EnemyParam or item table writes. Native rebuilds/equipment/scripts may replace values.
implementation.exclusions: Attack types5/6 and direct HP/script changes are separate. Zero also suppresses a native hit-response path. This is not guaranteed invulnerability.

openWork: Every native hit-response and script branch
